mapper.select: select count(*) as totalOrders, count(case when is_pay = 1 and is_taken = 0 then 1 end) as pending, coalesce(sum(case when is_pay = 1 then price end), 0) as totalRevenue, count(case when is_pay = 1 and date(pay_time) = curdate() then 1 end) as todayOrders, coalesce(sum(case when is_pay = 1 and date(pay_time) = curdate() then price end), 0) as todayRevenue, count(case when is_pay = 1 and date(pay_time) = date_sub(curdate(), interval 1 day) then 1 end) as yesterdayOrders, coalesce(sum(case when is_pay = 1 and date(pay_time) = date_sub(curdate(), interval 1 day) then price end), 0) as yesterdayRevenue from wxshop_order
select date(pay_time) as payDate, count(*) as orderCount from wxshop_order where is_pay = 1 and pay_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date(pay_time) order by payDate

select date(pay_time) as payDate, coalesce(sum(price), 0) as revenue from wxshop_order where is_pay = 1 and pay_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date(pay_time) order by payDate

select count(case when is_pay = 0 then 1 end) as unpaid, count(case when is_pay = 1 and is_taken = 0 then 1 end) as paid, count(case when is_pay = 1 and is_taken = 1 then 1 end) as taken, count(*) as total from wxshop_order

select f.id as food_id, f.name as food_name, f.price, c.name as category_name, sum(ofd.number) as sales, sum(ofd.price * ofd.number) as revenue from wxshop_order_food ofd join wxshop_food f on ofd.food_id = f.id join wxshop_category c on f.category_id = c.id join wxshop_order o on ofd.order_id = o.id where o.is_pay = 1 and o.pay_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) group by f.id, f.name, f.price, c.name order by sales desc limit #{limit}
